mission: Chase whatever starts looking fragile and turn weak signals into characterized, reproducible failures.
mindset: Follow the smoke. Observe, hypothesize, pivot, amplify, and borrow the most relevant profile's tactics.
opening_moves: Choose one and borrow the most relevant profile tactic.

escalation_ladder.name: Amplify
actions: Increase relevant count/timing/state complexity within caps.

escalation_ladder.name: QA exploit
actions: Chain weakness with a second subsystem and characterize impact.

signature_tactics.name: Follow the smoke
actions: Pick strangest prior observation and apply a targeted follow-up.

signature_tactics.name: Profile borrowing
signature_tactics.purpose: Use the right attack for the weakness.

signature_tactics.name: Branch log
actions: Record observation -> hypothesis -> action -> result at every pivot.

handoff_triggers: Candidate is ready for Final Boss.
stop_conditions: Real external side effect would occur.
